questions.text: Write x² + 8x – 5 in the form (x + p)² – q.
Find the discriminant of the quadratic equation 3x² + 5 = 11x.

Write as a single fraction in simplest form:

3/x + (x – 5)/(6x²) – 3/x
questions.markingGuide: 3/x – 3/x = 0. Expression simplifies to (x–5)/(6x²). Or via common denominator 6x²: 18x/(6x²) + (x–5)/(6x²) – 18x/(6x²) = (x–5)/(6x²).

questions.text:
A cubic polynomial f(x) = 2x³ + ax² + bx + c has roots –2, 1/2, and 4.

Find the values of a, b, and c.

questions.markingGuide: Numerator: factor x^(1/2) from first bracket: x^(1/2)(x+1). Factor x^(–1/2) from second: x^(–1/2)(x–1). Product = x^(1/2)·x^(–1/2)·(x+1)(x–1) = (x+1)(x–1). Denominator: x^(3/2)–x^(1/2) = x^(1/2)(x–1). Squared: x(x–1)². Result = (x+1)(x–1)/[x(x–1)²] = (x+1)/[x(x–1)]. Achieved = correct expansion of one part. Excellence = full proof.
Multiply both sides by x: 2x² + x = 10. 2x² + x – 10 = 0. Factorise: (2x + 5)(x – 2) = 0. So x = –5/2 or x = 2.

Numerator: 9x² + 12x + 4 = (3x + 2)². Denominator: 2x + 3x² = x(2 + 3x) = x(3x + 2). Cancel one factor of (3x + 2): (3x + 2)² / [x(3x + 2)] = (3x + 2) / x. Merit = correct simplified form with factorisation shown.

questions.text:
Find the value of k for which the equation

(x²–3x)/(2x–1) = (k–1)/(k+1)

has roots that are numerically equal but opposite in sign.
questions.markingGuide: Cross-multiply: (x²–3x)(k+1) = (k–1)(2x–1). Expand: (k+1)x²–3(k+1)x = 2(k–1)x–(k–1). Rearrange: (k+1)x² – [3(k+1)+2(k–1)]x + (k–1) = 0. (k+1)x² – (5k+1)x + (k–1) = 0. For roots equal and opposite, sum of roots = 0: (5k+1)/(k+1) = 0. 5k+1 = 0, k = –1/5.

questions.text:
A company emblem consists of two semicircles forming a wave shape, each with the same radius, arranged within a rectangle of width x. The rectangle's height equals its width.

Find an expression for the area of one semicircle in terms of x.
questions.markingGuide: Each semicircle has diameter = x/2 (two semicircles stack vertically in height x). So radius = x/4. Area of one semicircle = (1/2)π(x/4)² = πx²/32. Achieved = correct expression.

questions.text: If the uncovered area of the rectangle (not covered by the two semicircles) is 12.858 cm², find the width x.
questions.markingGuide: Rectangle area = x². Two semicircles = one full circle = π(x/4)² = πx²/16. Uncovered = x² – πx²/16 = x²(16–π)/16. Set equal to 12.858: x²(16–π)/16 = 12.858. x² = 12.858 × 16/(16–π) = 205.73/12.858 = 16. x = 4. Merit = correct x value.

questions.text: If log_b x = 4 and log_(3b) y = 4, write y in terms of x.
questions.markingGuide: From log_b x = 4: b⁴ = x. From log_(3b) y = 4: (3b)⁴ = y, so y = 81b⁴. Since b⁴ = x: y = 81x.
